facts.fact: TechnoMag reports that Zimbabwe officially launched its National AI Strategy 2026-2030, which establishes a Sovereign National Cloud to keep national data, including agricultural and mining data, on domestic servers; the article's publication date is used as the date.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National AI Strategy 2026-2030 (Sovereign National Cloud, data residency)

systems.owner: Government of Zimbabwe under the National AI Strategy; implementation by the AI Strategy Implementation Office
